entry_points.text: Deferred freeing forwards thin wrappers to workers that issue a release notice then queue the descriptor for batched reclaim. The fourth-level wrapper gates on five-level mode with full flush on extension builds.
Platform queries report whether frame modification checks are needed and handle failed and platform pages. Modification checking applies only on affected processors.

exports.text: Default virtualization hooks for table lifecycle are inert. Top reservation reports success while intermediate alloc, clone and free notices have no effect.
Linking installs a child table into its parent after a virtualization notice, marking the parent as a table. Kernel and process forms differ in frame derivation, top levels gate on five-level mode.

Slots are cleared, stored and taken with single updates. Takes return the prior value while emptying, checked and conditional installs add accounting or emptiness tests, and huge establish publishes while returning the displaced entry. Write-protect uses retry.

Predicates report dirtiness, youth, writability, huge shape, protection-none and accessibility from entry values. Permission needs present and user plus writable for writes, then protection-key allowance, with leaf checks for user access.

Constructors move entries among writable, protected and invalid forms, relocating hardware dirtiness to software storage on write removal and restoring on write add. Protection replacement keeps hardware status and frame while taking other bits anew.

Isolation flips a reserved address bit to select kernel or user top views and clones the shadow only when compiled and active. Folding is reported, top values preserve the shadow, fast GUP rejects kernel half, and cache refresh is a no-op.

hazards.text: Overwriting a differing present slot signals corruption and warns. Malformed entries log location and raw value. Fast paths must refuse kernel-half addresses.
Clearing writability while hardware dirtiness is set can forge the shadow-stack pattern, and hardware may set dirtiness concurrently. Affected paths relocate dirtiness and use atomic retry loops.

invariants.text: Top reservation order is one with isolation and zero otherwise. Kernel changes mirror to the user table below the kernel boundary unless skipped, adding no-execute for present user memory when supported. Safe installers warn once on differing present overwrite.
Split updates avoid tearing with ordered halves and barriers, read-clear uses exchange or retry, a bit helper repositions masked fields, and malformed values log location and raw content.

Malformed checks ignore benign user and accessed marks with conditional no-execute tolerance, top presence folds to constants without five-level mode, and shadow-stack applies only with the feature active.
Table code relies on external single load, single store and atomic exchange plus compare-exchange for shared updates. Definitions live outside this dossier.

locks.text: Simple stores use single volatile writes under caller exclusion. Shared takes use atomic exchange on multiprocessor and load-plus-clear otherwise, while in-place changes retry compare-exchange. No spinlock is taken.

state_machines.text: Huge slots cycle between installed and empty. Clear returns the evicted value while emptying, establish installs anew while returning the displaced one, with the checking layer observing each transition.

structs.text: Two-level values are one machine word, three-level and sixty-four-bit values are sixty-four-bit quantities in distinct single-field wrappers per level. Frame shift equals page shift.
Sixty-four-bit tables hold five hundred twelve entries per level with middle shift twenty-one and upper shifts thirty and thirty-nine, variable top shift, and sizes derived from shifts.
Maximum memory is one shifted by physical bits. Guard hole, descriptor slot, vmalloc and vmemmap bases differ for four- and five-level modes with derived starts.

Module space follows the kernel image, fixup and entry trampolines sit near the top, the firmware window spans a fixed range, early tables are sixty-four, and kernel top start derives from entry size.

Kernel half geometry derives from the direct-map top index, the swapper directory aliases the initial top table, sync scope follows five-level state, index width is log2 entries, and precise sampling reserves enable and tag bits with low metric codes.
